header.description: The harvest das_pca_init.json's basis is fitted over: block_output at the located cell (block 23, the answer slot), one un-intervened forward over the 30 training pairs. The basis's rank is 16, not the 32 the Llama-era document asked for: a PCA cannot hold more components than it has rows, and 30 pairs bound it below 32 - so das_pca_init.json's widest rank is 16 here too. No writes, hence no intervened_models; the tensor it saves is what workflows/pca_basis.json hands to causalab.analysis.fit_pca, whose output is then placed at artifacts/weekdays/qwen25_7b/pca/block_output_L23.safetensors for das_pca_init.json to start from (scripts/run_all.py does the placing).
